comment: The two outputs are the two roots of the same phase-distortion equation, which is why the module has two of them rather than a mix control; the maker's manual works the algebra through. At Funs.cpp:104-110 the two waves are swapped for odd-numbered polyphony channels. The base frequency uses the same C0 literal, 16.35159783128741466737, as Ad and Sjang. XMAX_PARAM is declared in the ParamId enum but never configured and never given a widget, so it cannot be reached at all.
